framework: Snapshot signaling + Risk Committee + GnosisSafe execution
votingUnit: ENA token (sENA holders have expanded voting rights on tokenomics)
proposalRequirements: Proposals are discussed for ~7 days on gov.ethenafoundation.com, then put to Snapshot vote at snapshot.org/#/ethenagovernance.eth. Most operational decisions are delegated to elected committees (Risk Committee, etc.); the 5-of-10 GnosisSafe executes approved actions on-chain.
votingProcess: Forum discussion (~7d) → Snapshot vote → 5/10 GnosisSafe executes. No on-chain timelock; committees handle most decisions.

proposalPeriod.value: ~7 days forum discussion + Snapshot voting period
